_comment: NOT IMPLEMENTED, deliberately empty rather than guessed. Three clauses, none expressible: a once-per-turn permission to play blood-debt action cards from the banished zone, an end-phase optional banish from hand, and a self-destruct conditional on whether a blood-debt card was banished THIS TURN (no such turn marker is recorded). Unique is a printed keyword. The file exists to stop create_token aborting the game.
